result.summary: This is a mobile app screen for setting a blood glucose target range, featuring input fields for upper and lower limits and informational text about optimal levels.

ocr.full_text:
9:41
Blood Glucose
What is your target range?
We use this to determine if your logged glucose levels are in range.
Upper Limit
10 mmol/L
Lower Limit
4 mmol/L
A blood sugar level of 4 to 7 mmol/L before food and 4.0 to 10 mmol/L after food is optimal. However, do note that your targets may vary depending on your condition, and thus, you should discuss it with your doctor or care team.
SET TARGET RANGE
Fitbit
